Title: General availability: Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB API

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB API is now generally available. You can now easily migrate your Mongo DB apps and use familiar MongoDB tool chains, skills, and drivers to code against the Azure Cosmos DB database engine.

The Azure Cosmos DB for Mongo DB API now supports sharded collections, globally replicated databases, additional Azure portal metrics, and much more. To learn more, see the API for MongoDB overview page.
